message.content:
**計算步驟**

\[
I=\int_{1}^{5}x^{3}\,\mathrm{d}x
\]

先對 \(x^{3}\) 做不定積分：

\[
\int x^{3}\,\mathrm{d}x=\frac{x^{4}}{4}+C
\]

再帶入上下限：

\[
I=\left[\frac{x^{4}}{4}\right]_{1}^{5}
   =\frac{5^{4}-1^{4}}{4}
   =\frac{625-1}{4}
   =\frac{624}{4}=156
\]

---

### 結果  
\[
\boxed{\displaystyle \int_{1}^{5}x^{3}\,\mathrm{d}x = 156 }
\]
如果你想確認或進一步驗證，隨時告訴我！
